shared_elements: horizontal/vertical bands of repeated geometric marks
justification: The strongest overlap is that both surfaces use schematic relief/incised conventions with circular signs, repeated geometric bands, and some body- or creature-like imagery on a vertical field. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by multiple separate profile animals/birds and sign-like motifs arranged in registers, while B is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic figure or mask-like body with circular features and radiating/geometric decoration.
